issue.title: Bare bob plugins sync from a SASE worktree deploys the canonical checkout
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-56.2 note #1 while landing the Task Link lane toggle.

Root cause: `bob plugins sync` resolves the plugins repo through `plugins_dir()` in `src/native/env.rs` (`BOB_PLUGINS_DIR`, otherwise `~/projects/github/bobs-org/bob-plugins`) and `src/native/plugins/git.rs` runs `git pull` on that checkout before copying managed files into the vault. A SASE phase edits the linked worktree from `sase repo open bob-plugins`. A bare sync does not look at that worktree, so it deploys whatever the canonical checkout pulls, including an older sibling plugin another phase has already deployed.

Observed on 2026-10-07 during bob-cli-56: a bare sync rolled vault ledger-tools 1.34.0 back to 1.33.0. The phase restored that deployment from the sync backup and redeployed navigation-hotkeys only with `--repo` and `-p`.

bob-cli-4g mentions syncing from the opened linked checkout as a verification step for a harness migration. It is not this defect.

Active epics bob-cli-28, bob-cli-3j, and bob-cli-52 do not own plugins sync. bob-cli-56 is closing and does not change sync.

Fix: when the current directory is inside a bob-plugins checkout that is not the resolved repo, abort before pull or copy and tell the caller to pass `--repo` to that checkout (and `-p` when only one plugin should move). Say the same thing in bob-plugins `AGENTS.md`, which currently says only to run `bob plugins sync`. A normal sync from outside a plugins checkout keeps today's default.

task_type_fields.impact: Concurrent epic phases clobber each other's vault deployments. The vault copy is what Obsidian loads, so a sibling plugin silently reverts while the worktree commit stays correct.
task_type_fields.repro: From a SASE linked bob-plugins worktree that is ahead of ~/projects/github/bobs-org/bob-plugins, deploy one plugin with `bob plugins sync --repo <worktree> -p <id>`, then run bare `bob plugins sync` with no `--repo`. The second command git-pulls the canonical checkout and copies its managed files over the vault, reverting the plugin the worktree just deployed. bob-cli-56.2 saw ledger-tools go from 1.34.0 back to 1.33.0 this way.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-56.2 saw a bare `bob plugins sync` deploy ~/projects/github/bobs-org/bob-plugins and roll the vault's ledger-tools from 1.34.0 back to 1.33.0, undoing a sibling phase that had just synced from the linked worktree.

payload.entry: Guard landed: bare bob plugins sync from a foreign bob-plugins checkout refuses (exit 2) before any pull or copy, in dry-run too; explicit --repo, resolved-checkout cwd, and unrelated cwd unchanged. Verified with 4 new CLI tests in tests/cli/plugins.rs plus docs/plugins.md and bob-plugins AGENTS.md (commit 856afc9); lib 1896 passed, cli 1163/1164 (sole failure is the pre-existing DISPLAY/xclip env failure, reproduced on clean base).
